stem.en: According to the oath of coronation in the Yajurveda, what was a king advised to do?

text.en: Favour the strong, because they can defend the kingdom.
Judge the strong and the weak fairly, protect the country from calamities, and do good to the people.
Leave all judgement to his officers and attend only to war.
Protect his own family first, and then the people.

explanation.en: The oath advises the king to judge the strong and the weak impartially and fairly, to protect the country from all calamities, and to do good to the people.

hints.en: The first part is about treating people of unequal power in the same way.
